::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--lanes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
bcl2fastq option. Semicolon-delimited series of lanes to demultiplex. Use this if you have a sample sheet for an entire flow cell but only want to generate a few lanes for further 10x Genomics analysis.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"1,3"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `","`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_bases_mask`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
bcl2fastq option. Use to clip extra bases off a read if you ran extra cycles for QC.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"y50n,I6n,Y50n"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `","`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--delete_undetermined`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
bcl2fastq option. Delete the Undetermined FASTQs generated by bcl2fastq. Useful if you are demultiplexing a small number of samples from a large flow cell.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--barcode_mismatches`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
bcl2fastq option. Use this option to change the number of allowed mismatches per index adapter (0, 1, 2).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`

::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/demux/cellranger_atac_mkfastq/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/demux/cellranger_atac_mkfastq);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/demux/cellranger_atac_mkfastq/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
